description: Shorti(쇼티) for «check my take» or «내가 찍은 거 봐줘». The person's own video checked against its format's hits. `url` (a posted Reels, TikTok or Short): the page on Shorti to paste it on, the first one free. `upload`: their own file, on that page. `token`: their summary, once they send it to this chat. Its feedback (피드백): a likeness is not a forecast of views.

token.description: The token a previous call gave.

upload.description: Their own file (shot, edited or generated).

url.description: Their posted Reels, TikTok or Shorts link.

name: shorti_check
title: Check my video
